title: SafeGPT: Preventing Data Leakage and Unethical Outputs in Enterprise LLM Use

bias_targets.methodology: Demonstrated through a qualitative case study where the system's output-side guardrail detects and automatically reframes age-coded, discriminatory language in a simulated employee performance review.
Evaluated using the synthetic ToxicChat dataset to test the output-side guardrail's precision, recall, and ability to enforce policy compliance by identifying abusive or harmful language.
